title: Working out a plant that has changed
description: Gather photographs and the care history, pin down the signs observed and save the examination of the case.

blocks.text: The owner notices a change and opens a separate case: the whole plant, a close-up, the date it appeared and the most recent actions. The clarifications relate to the visible sign rather than starting the general advice for the species all over again.

quote.text: Great for identifying plants. As far as helping diagnose plant issues not so much. I uploaded 10 different plants this app literally gave me the same diagnosis for 7 out of 10

blocks.text: Work through one case step by step
A first version can be limited to gathering observations and comparing them with clear questions. The next snapshot is added to the same case, so it is visible what changed after the action chosen.
The limits of an answer from a snapshot

A general name for the problem with no explanation of the signs does not finish the job. Specific advice needs a checked basis in content; where there is not enough of it, preparing the history for a specialist is more useful than confidently picking one of two opposite causes.
